activity_statements.statement: delivers custom software engineering and product development services to enterprises in financial services, healthcare, manufacturing, and other sectors
implements AI and generative AI transformation programs (AI.Run.Transform) for Fortune 2000 clients, recognized by Gartner as a GenAI consulting leader
provides digital experience design and UX consulting through EPAM Continuum for clients seeking product strategy and user experience transformation
supplies cloud architecture, data engineering, and platform engineering services partnering with Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud
operates engineering talent delivery centers in Eastern Europe, India, Latin America, and other regions serving 345+ global enterprise clients

name_reality_gap: Name and index label ('Technology & AI') correctly describe an IT services company. However, EPAM is often mistaken for a product company — it is a pure services/consulting firm that builds products for others, not one that ships its own software products at scale.
extraction_notes: Very detailed about page. Strong data on scale (62,750+ employees, 55+ countries, 345+ clients). AI offerings explicitly named. Function mix clearly dominated by software engineering headcount.
